title: Stunning Wood To Gas Hargrove Colonial Cannon Ball Spheres
description: Another successful wood-to-gas fireplace conversion in the books! Our latest installation features the stunning Hargrove Colonial Cannon Ball Spheres, which are designed to impress. These gas vented fireplace balls are a true work of art and have completely transformed our client's home. Not only do they add an eye-catching focal point to the room, but they also offer the convenience of gas. Thanks to our team of expert installers and quality products, we were able to deliver another outstanding fireplace upgrade.
